born.why: The code prioritizes starvation prevention, avoids known poisonous species by key, and uses a "taste first" strategy for new species if there is a baseline of safe experiences (preventing catastrophic errors on unknowns with no context), while eating confirmed safe species immediately for efficiency.
It prioritizes safety by tasting unknown fruits and avoiding known poisons, while using recency-weighted memory to balance risk-taking when hunger is high versus caution when well-fed.

This code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starving, avoids confirmed poison, and uses trait-based learning (color/smell) to infer safety for new fruits of similar appearance, balancing the need for information gathering (tasting) against the risk of starvation.
